metaDescription: How ForThePeople.in handles your data. Fully compliant with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.
title: Privacy policy
simple: We collect as little about you as we can, we never sell it, and you can ask us to show, correct or delete it.
glanceLabel: The privacy policy at a glance
glance1: No cookies and no advertising trackers.
glance2: We never ask for Aadhaar, PAN or any other ID.
glance3: Payments go through Razorpay. We never see your card or UPI details.
glance4: Ask to see, correct or delete your data by writing to support@forthepeople.in.
t2Caption: What data we process, why, and the legal basis
t4Caption: How long we keep each kind of data, and why
t8Caption: Where each processor stores or processes data
t12Caption: Third-party services we use and their privacy policies

body.s1a: ForThePeople.in is an independent citizen transparency platform built by Jayanth M B in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. It is not an official government website. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, process, and protect your personal data, in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.
body.s1b: By using this platform, you agree to the practices described below.
body.s1operator: Operator: Jayanth M B, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

r1.what: SHA-256 hash of IP + browser user-agent (not reversible)
r1.purpose: Prevent duplicate votes on the features page

r2.what: Email you voluntarily enter in the feedback form

r3.what: Name, email, contribution amount, optional social handle
r3.purpose: Process contributions, display on contributor page if opted in

r4.what: Card, UPI, bank details — processed entirely by Razorpay. We never see or store these.

r5.what: IP address, browser type, request URL, timestamp

r6.what: Stack traces, browser type, URL. No personal identifiers captured.

r7.what: Aggregated page views, referrer country. No cookies, no personal identifiers.
r7.purpose: Understand which districts and modules are useful

s3.n1: Aadhaar, PAN, voter ID, driving licence, or any government-issued ID
s3.n2: Personal data of citizens from government portals (we only collect aggregated/statistical data)
s3.n3: Cookies — zero cookies of any kind on this platform
s3.n4: Tracking pixels or third-party advertising trackers
s3.n7: Financial account numbers or credit card details
s3.n8: Your contacts, photos, or device storage
s3.noSale: We do NOT sell, rent, license, or share your data with advertisers or data brokers.

r2.howLong: Until the feature is built, shipped, or removed — max 24 months

r3.why: Indian Income Tax Act record-keeping requirement

r6.howLong: Aggregated indefinitely; individual visit data not retained

s5.intro: You have the following rights over your personal data:
s5.r1: Right to Access: Request a copy of what we hold about you
s5.r2: Right to Correction: Request correction of inaccurate data
s5.r3: Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (subject to legal retention requirements)
s5.r4: Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw previously given consent at any time (this does not affect processing that occurred before withdrawal)
s5.r5: Right to Grievance Redressal: Raise concerns about our data practices and receive a response
s5.r6: Right to Nominate: Nominate another individual to exercise these rights in case of your death or incapacity
s5.how: How to exercise: Email support@forthepeople.in with the subject line "DPDP Data Request". We will respond within 30 days. If you are unsatisfied with our response, you have the right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Board of India.

s6.intro: Under DPDP Act 2023, we have designated the following as our Grievance Officer:
s6.name: Name: Jayanth M B

body.s7a: ForThePeople.in is not directed at children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. Feature voting uses anonymous fingerprints that cannot identify individuals, including minors. If you are a parent or guardian and believe a child has submitted personal data (for example, via the feedback form), please contact us immediately at <mail>support@forthepeople.in</mail> and we will delete it within 72 hours.
body.s7b: Under DPDP Act 2023, we do not engage in targeted advertising or behavioural monitoring of children.
body.s8intro: Some of our processors store or process data on servers outside India. We disclose these clearly:

neon.location: Can be configured per region; currently hosted in an Asia region

body.s8outro: These transfers are made under contractual safeguards with each processor. The Government of India may from time to time restrict certain countries for cross-border transfers under DPDP Act 2023; we will update this list if that happens.

s9.intro: We use automated systems and AI models for:
s9.i1: News classification (assigning news articles to relevant modules such as Infrastructure, Elections, Health)
s9.i2: AI insights and summaries on each module page
s9.outro: These systems do not make decisions that produce legal or significant effects on you as an individual — they only classify and summarise public information. If you believe an AI-generated summary is incorrect or unfair to you, please report it via feedback and we will review within 24 hours.

s10.i1: AES-256 encryption for sensitive data at rest
s10.i2: TLS 1.2+ (HTTPS) for all data in transit
s10.i3: Two-factor authentication (Google Authenticator TOTP) on the admin panel
s10.i4: HMAC-SHA256 payment signature verification for all Razorpay webhooks
s10.i5: No plaintext passwords anywhere in our systems

body.s11: In the event of a personal data breach that is likely to result in risk to you, we will notify affected users within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach, as required under DPDP Act 2023. Notifications will include the nature of the breach, data affected, actions being taken, and steps you can take to protect yourself. We will also notify the Data Protection Board of India within the required timeframe.
body.s13: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time as our data practices or applicable laws change. Material changes will be highlighted at the top of this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Your continued use of the platform after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

s14.operator: Operator: Jayanth M B, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
